reconciliation.m520: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_PRESERVED: timeout produced no lifecycle receipt; no later state inference is permitted.
reconciliation.m527: BLOCKED_PRESERVED: valid PASS:previewed persisted session prevented clean-session entry; ownership was not established.
reconciliation.m532: BLOCKED_PRESERVED: transport PASS and fixture/preview evidence stopped before lifecycle; session-preflight was PASS:previewed and ownership was OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN.
reconciliation.ownershipContract: M529/M530 ownership is non-reconstructable after the current-process capability boundary; the persisted session cannot be retroactively authorized.
reconciliation.storageContract: The current session key is derived solely from project identity, and valid nonterminal sessions cannot be replaced or cleared.
reconciliation.decision: Use a closed typed self-test session namespace paired with a distinct fixed test-owned target identity. A different key alone is insufficient because it would create competing sessions over the occupied project.
rejectedActions: recover, cancel, clear, replace, or reuse the preserved session
reuse the occupied project under only a different session key
capture, retry, build, launch, or mutate runtime/project state

nextBoundary.scope: Code-only typed isolation for the broken-reference self-test: keep the ordinary project session key and behavior compatible, add a closed self-test namespace bound to a distinct fixed test-owned target identity, and preserve exact ownership/history gates.
acceptance: ordinary project-key format and behavior remain compatible
self-test namespace and target identity are closed and cannot be caller-arbitrarily selected
cross-namespace reads, writes, migration, terminalization, and clearing are rejected
nonterminal, malformed, foreign, authority-mismatched, or drifted test sessions fail closed
current-process ownership token remains nonserialized and bound to exact batch and command identity
memory-storage tests prove key separation, cross-namespace isolation, mismatch rejection, and token non-persistence
prohibited: Foundry, provider, credential, or player-password action

notes: M533 selects one safe code-only boundary; it does not certify Stage 11, lifecycle completion, Foundry authority, or Ready-to-Play.
